method: English public search queries and first-party competitor pages, combined with the current Finflo registry. Search results were not controlled for searcher location and are not a country-specific rank report. Query phrases are intent candidates, not verified search volumes. No traffic, difficulty, revenue or citation metrics were available.

marketOrder.reason: Percentage, arithmetic, dates, units and compound-growth scenarios can serve shared needs without inventing local tax rules.
Existing mortgage, tax and retirement models explicitly implement US assumptions. Prioritize accuracy and year maintenance before expansion.
Existing dedicated mortgage pages have distinct methods. Improve their regional explanations and references before proposing new pages.
Moneysmart is a relevant public competitor. Finflo has no independently verified Australian tax or home-loan product model; validate demand and scope before expansion.

queries: compound interest calculator with monthly contributions

competitors.observation: The initial tool converts compounding rates and directs growth calculations to a separate interest page.
Exposes deposits, withdrawals and compounding frequencies with named authorship.

clusters.opportunity: Keep the growth-first default. Explain contribution timing with one checked example. Assign generic compound-growth intent to this URL; interest covers tax and dual contribution streams, savings covers deposit timing, and investment covers target solving.
clusters.confidence: High for observed intent differences; demand and ranking potential unmeasured
clusters.validation: Independently verify the example and both timing modes; check existing URLs and internal links.

queries: mortgage calculator with taxes and insurance
how much house can I afford

competitors.observation: Existing catalog audit records ownership costs, amortization and extra-payment controls.
Separates principal and interest from mortgage insurance, escrow and other closing disclosures.

clusters.opportunity: Explain total ownership cost and extra-principal treatment beside the existing schedule. Keep payoff, schedule and affordability intents distinct; avoid new variations of the main mortgage page.
clusters.confidence: High for product and content scope
clusters.validation: Compare the principal-and-interest example with the annuity formula and confirm zero-rate behavior.

competitors.observation: Distinguishes term from amortization and includes prepayment/payment-frequency inputs.
Explains renewal and the difference between the current agreement and full repayment period.

clusters.opportunity: Label the years input as amortization. Replace generic US references with FCAC references and state that renewals, financed insurance premiums and lender eligibility are not calculated.
clusters.validation: Check the monthly rate against nominal semiannual conversion and verify CAD presentation.

competitors.observation: Covers repayment and interest-only estimates and the effect of changed rates.
Explains the outstanding capital and need for a repayment plan.

clusters.opportunity: Use UK references and clarify that the entered rate is fixed for the scenario, not a predicted renewal rate. Make the outstanding capital in interest-only mode explicit.
clusters.validation: Verify an independent interest-only example and GBP output.

competitors.observation: Presents current-versus-refinanced loan comparisons.

clusters.opportunity: Explain why payment-only break-even can differ from the existing common-horizon comparison. Keep both ending balances and upfront costs visible.
clusters.validation: Check equal-loan and zero-savings cases; retain existing cash-flow tests.

competitors.observation: Provides dedicated percentage-change explanations and a calculation tool.
Separates common percentage intents in a directory.

clusters.opportunity: Add a short percentage-points comparison and reverse-discount example to the existing multi-mode page. Map retail savings to percent-off, chained reductions to discount and measurement error to percent-error.
clusters.validation: Check 80 after a 20 percent discount returns 100; distinguish 5 to 6 percent as one point and 20 percent relative change.

competitors.observation: Official adult screening calculator.
Uses age- and sex-specific child/teen percentiles and explains interpretation limits.

clusters.opportunity: Preserve adult/child separation, state CDC scope and ages, and improve the translations of screening and clinician interpretation. Avoid diagnostic or weight-loss promises.
clusters.validation: Check adult unit equivalence and existing pediatric LMS/extended reference fixtures.

competitors.observation: Offers a TDEE calculator with explanatory health context.

clusters.opportunity: Differentiate resting expenditure, maintenance expenditure and macro allocation. Use assumptions rather than weight-loss promises as the distinguishing explanation.
clusters.validation: Verify equation selection, adult restrictions and activity-factor interpretation.

competitors.observation: Makes end-date inclusion explicit and links duration, addition and workday tools.
Explains business-day and business-date tools.

clusters.opportunity: Clarify custom holiday and observation rules, end-date inclusion and month-end clamping. Keep simple day counting as a focused entry point, with full calendar operations on date-calculator.
clusters.validation: Verify leap years, month-end clamping and holiday exclusion with independent calendar cases.

competitors.observation: Explains weighted scores using the sum of score-times-weight divided by total weight.
Provides a separate final-grade target tool.

clusters.opportunity: Keep target solving within the existing grade page and emphasize impossible targets and explicit letter scales. Do not add a duplicate final-grade URL.
clusters.validation: Check unequal weights and a required final score over 100 percent.

queries: gross salary to net pay US

competitors.observation: Primary source confirms 2026 standard deductions and bracket thresholds; this is reference evidence, not a competing calculator.

clusters.opportunity: Prioritize effective-year maintenance, payroll terminology and limitations over new regional tax pages. A currency display change must never imply a different tax jurisdiction.
clusters.confidence: High for supported year; demand unmeasured
clusters.validation: Reconcile constants to IRS publications and retain independent tax fixtures.

competitors.observation: Explains first and subsequent distribution deadlines and account distinctions; reference evidence.

clusters.opportunity: Correct ambiguous RMD deadline labels and keep generic projections separate from account-specific eligibility. Preserve unresolved-policy guards.
clusters.effort: Small label fix; ongoing policy review
clusters.validation: Verify historical birth cohorts and ensure labels describe the dates actually shown.

competitors.observation: Official Australian mortgage tool considers loan repayments and interest-rate sensitivity.

clusters.opportunity: Use generic arithmetic only within its stated assumptions. Do not relabel the US mortgage as Australian or create a country page without local method and demand evidence.
clusters.confidence: Medium for competitor relevance; low for market priority
clusters.validation: Review actual country demand once Search Console is available; independently specify any proposed Australian model.

unresearchedFamilies: All 203 existing catalog pages have a page-intent inventory and corresponding competitor-page evidence from the October 9 audit. Outside the 13 researched clusters, query phrasing is catalog-derived and demand remains unmeasured. No bulk page creation is recommended.
successMeasures: All candidate intents resolve to one chosen existing primary URL.
Measure English page/query clicks, impressions and CTR over comparable post-recrawl periods when reports are available.
Compare country/device segments and annotate releases; do not attribute every change to this work.
Record representative AI citations manually with query, platform and date when observed; do not claim complete AI visibility.
